Testing and code checks¶

The existing news/tests.py file covers reader access, the journalist and editor actions, subscription filtering, newsletters, API permissions, and approval notifications.

Run these commands after installing the requirements:

python manage.py check
python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
python manage.py test
flake8 .

Build the HTML documentation with Sphinx:

sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html

Open docs/_build/html/index.html in a browser to read the finished docs. Keep the generated HTML output when uploading the project to GitHub.

The checks should be run again after making any code changes, especially if changing database settings or Docker files.
